## Nowhere to go but up — four or fewer wins with a poor turnover ratio

*Steve Makinen, pp. 22–24.*

**As printed.** Since 2021, there have been 21 teams that have won four or fewer games in a season while enduring a -0.8 or worse turnover ratio. Over the last five seasons, the average winning percentage increase of the 21 teams that have done this has been 15.2% SU (+2.1 wins) and 13.3% ATS.

## Heisman base rates

*Zach Cohen, p. 39.*

**As printed.** Only five non-quarterbacks have won since 2000, Travis Hunter in 2024 being the exception. Four of the last five winners have been quarterbacks since NIL money began flowing openly in July 2021. Three of the last four winners transferred in from another power programme — Caleb Williams, Jayden Daniels and Fernando Mendoza. The preseason favourite rarely wins: if CJ Carr or Arch Manning were to win it would be the first time since 2014.
